description: v2.2.9 (pre-release): Reddit save-flow stability hardening — 'Remove ads' Layer 3 (comment-banner ad loader) rewritten as a constant return-void entry kill (zero registers used, no branch, no label) replacing the previous move-result-into-v0 short circuit; Layer 5 (AdPostSection Compose-render no-op) retained ON by explicit decision (2026-11-07) with keep-decision docs; new off-by-default patch 'Reddit: Diagnostic crash log' injects an uncaught-exception hook at the verified Moshi AccountJsonAdapter constructor and writes Downloads/reddit-crash-*.txt with device/app version header (chains to the original handler); new docs/REDDIT-STABILITY.md. Layer 5 remains the open risk on the save path; no device verification yet. Latest full release remains v2.2.4; v2.2.8 unchanged.
